name: Bootstrap the checkout
description: The use cases the checkout implements today, read from its code.

useCases.name: Charge shipping at checkout
useCases.description: An order with a subtotal of 100 or more pays no shipping, and a member never pays shipping, whatever the subtotal. Every other order pays a flat shipping fee of exactly 15.

behaviors.name: Free shipping from 100
behaviors.description: An order with a subtotal of 100 or more pays no shipping.

behaviors.name: Members ship free
behaviors.description: A member never pays shipping, whatever the subtotal.

behaviors.name: Flat fee of 15
behaviors.description: A non-member order under 100 pays a shipping fee of exactly 15.

notCovered.reason: a second copy of the fee with an off-by-one; ask which one ships
